go.title: Go live
go.audioOnlySub: Your live is voice only. Listeners see your cover photo and can ask to join you on stage.
go.coverHint: Optional. Shown on the live list and behind the stage.

privacy.publicSub: Anyone on FLYP can find and join your live.
privacy.privateSub: Nobody else can join. Useful for a test run.

go.rules: Lives follow the FLYP community guidelines. Anyone can report a live.
go.micBody: A live is your voice. Allow FLYP to use the microphone in Settings to go live.
go.coverRefused: This cover photo can't be used. Choose another one or go live without a cover.
go.coverFailed: Couldn't upload the cover photo. Try again or go live without one.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.balanceFailed: Couldn't load your balance. Tap to retry.
wallet.balanceSub: Use coins to send gifts in lives.
wallet.how2: Pay securely through {{store}}. FLYP never sees your card details.
wallet.how3: Your coins arrive once {{store}} confirms the purchase.
wallet.priceNote: Prices are set by {{store}} in your local currency.
wallet.loadFailed: Couldn't load this. Pull to refresh.
wallet.storeUnavailable: Couldn't reach {{store}}, so coins can't be bought right now. Check that you're signed in to {{store}} and online.
wallet.simulator: Buying coins needs a real phone. It isn't available in a simulator or emulator.
wallet.unsupported: Coins can only be bought in the FLYP app on iPhone or Android.

result.creditedBody_one: {{n}} coin was added to your wallet.
result.creditedBody_other: {{n}} coins were added to your wallet.
result.pendingBody: {{store}} is still processing your payment. Your coins are added automatically once it's complete.
result.retryLaterBody: We couldn't confirm your purchase with {{store}} yet. We'll keep trying automatically. You won't be charged again, and your coins will arrive.
result.otherAccountBody: This purchase was made from another FLYP account, so its coins were added to that account.
result.otherAccountWaitBody: This purchase was made from another FLYP account. Sign in to that account to receive its coins.
result.invalidBody: {{store}} didn't confirm this purchase, so no coins were added. If you were charged, request a refund from {{store}}.
result.failedBody: {{store}} couldn't complete the purchase. You haven't been charged. Please try again.

creator.title: Creator earnings
creator.intro: Gifts you receive in lives earn you diamonds. Once they clear, you can withdraw them to your bank.
creator.withheldNote: Some diamonds are under review because of a refund or unusual activity on the sender's account. They can't be withdrawn unless the review clears them. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
creator.holdNote: Diamonds from each gift become available {{days}} days after you receive it.
creator.cancelBody: The diamonds go back to your available balance.

block.payouts_paused: Withdrawals are paused for now. Your diamonds are safe.
block.no_birth_date: We don't have your date of birth, so we can't confirm you're {{age}} or older. Contact support to withdraw.
block.under_age: Withdrawals are only available to people aged {{age}} and over.
block.account_too_new: Withdrawals open once your account is {{days}} days old. Days left: {{left}}.
block.account_restricted: Withdrawals aren't available while your account is restricted.
block.account_flagged: Your wallet is under review, so withdrawals are paused until it's cleared.
block.on_hold: Withdrawals are on hold for your account. Contact support for details.
block.kyc_missing: To withdraw, verify your identity and the bank account to pay into. You only do this once.
block.kyc_pending: We're reviewing your details. This usually takes 1–3 business days.
block.kyc_rejected: Your verification wasn't approved: {{reason}}. You can correct your details and send them again.
block.kyc_rejectedPlain: Your verification wasn't approved. You can correct your details and send them again.
block.open_withdrawal: You have a withdrawal in progress. You can request another once it's finished.
block.below_minimum: You can withdraw once you have at least {{min}} SAR available.
block.unavailable: Withdrawals aren't available for your account right now.

kyc.title: Verify identity
kyc.privacy: We need these details to confirm who we're paying, as banks and the law require. Your ID photo is stored in a private area that only you and FLYP's payments team can open. We use these details only to verify you, pay you and prevent fraud, and keep them as described in our Privacy Policy. They are never shown on your profile.
kyc.legalName: Full legal name (as on your ID)
kyc.idPhoto: Photo of the front of your ID
kyc.ibanHint: Saudi IBAN: SA followed by 22 digits.
kyc.owner: This IBAN is in my own name
kyc.ownerHint: We can only pay into an account held in the name on your ID.
kyc.reviewNote: Changing your bank details later sends them for review again.
kyc.submittedBody: We'll review your details, usually within 1–3 business days, and notify you.
kyc.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Allow it in Settings, or choose a photo instead.

amount.title: Withdraw
amount.label: Amount in SAR
amount.feeNote: FLYP charges no withdrawal fee. Your bank may charge a fee for incoming transfers.
amount.manualNote: Our team checks each request and sends it by bank transfer, usually within 3–5 business days of approval.

confirm.title: Confirm withdrawal
confirm.name: Account holder
confirm.doneBody: We'll notify you when it's approved and again when the money is on its way.
